preconditions.description: The number of hashtags n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(hashtag) <= 500000 for hashtag in hashtags)
preconditions.description: Each hashtag has a length between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
Each hashtag starts with the '#' symbol.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in hashtag[1:]) for hashtag in hashtags)
preconditions.description: Each hashtag consists of lowercase English letters after the '#' symbol.
The total length of all hashtags (excluding the '#' symbols) does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: Each resulting hashtag starts with the '#' symbol.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in hashtag[1:]) for hashtag in result)
postconditions.description: Each resulting hashtag consists of lowercase English letters after the '#' symbol.

postconditions.expression: all(result[i] <= result[i + 1] for i in range(len(result) - 1))
postconditions.description: The resulting hashtags are in lexicographical order.
